problems.title: Subsurface Heavy Metal Leaching into Rural Borewells
problems.description: Arsenic and manganese leaching into borewells across East Singhbhum villages. Need low-cost IoT filtration pilots aligned with Jal Jeevan Mission.
problems.solutionNotes: Low-cost filtration cartridge prototype with LoRa telemetry; field trial plan for 3 villages.

problems.title: Unpredictable Post-Harvest Tomato Glut Causing Distress Sales
problems.description: Farmers around Ranchi lose 30-40% of tomato produce every season due to price crashes. Need solar micro cold-storage network and price-alert app.

problems.title: Overheated Sub-Station Transformers During Summer Load
problems.description: Distribution transformers in Bokaro industrial belt overheat during peak summer causing blackouts. Need predictive thermal monitoring retrofit.
problems.solutionNotes: Deployed thermal cutoff pilot across 40 units; zero outages in August heat cycle.

problems.title: Coal Mine Slope Instability Threatening Worker Safety
problems.description: Open-cast mines near Dhanbad show micro-displacements before collapse. Need early-warning sensor mesh and evacuation protocol automation.
problems.solutionNotes: Tiltmeter + piezometer mesh spec, 90-day geotech validation underway.

problems.title: Ambulance Response Delays in Forested Districts
problems.description: Emergency response times exceed 90 minutes in Palamu and Latehar forest zones. Need hub-and-spoke tele-triage with two-wheeler first responders.

problems.title: Tribal Students Dropping Out After Class 8 in Remote Blocks
problems.description: Transition rates from middle to secondary school fall sharply in Khunti and Gumla due to distance and lack of hostels. Need mobile learning + community hostel pilot.

problems.title: Arsenic Test Kits Unavailable at Village Level
problems.description: Field health workers lack rapid arsenic test kits in Simdega. Need low-cost colorimetric kit distribution and reporting workflow.
